title: Tools for underwriting small business borrowers | Middesk
summary: Compare the software tools commercial lenders use to verify business identity, review bank transactions, check liens, and automate underwriting rules.
body_markdown:
#### How do automated underwriting tools improve loan decision speed?


Tools can retrieve records and move data between systems without repeated lookups or retyping. The time saved depends on source availability, integration quality, and how many files still need review. Measure the change in your own workflow rather than assuming a days-to-minutes result.


#### What role does open banking play in small business underwriting?


Open banking lets a borrower authorize a service to access financial-account data. For underwriting, that data can support analysis of balances, recurring payments, and cash flow. Confirm which accounts and periods are included, and reconcile deposits before calling them revenue.


#### Can smaller lenders implement automated underwriting without custom engineering?


Pre-built integrations can reduce custom development, but they still need configuration and testing. Ask the provider to demonstrate your data sources, lending rules, exception queues, and decision records before estimating the work required.


#### Should a lender replace credit bureau data with alternative data?


Not by default. Bank transactions, accounting records, and business verification answer questions a bureau report may not cover. Test whether each additional source improves the lender’s assessment and whether the same information is already available elsewhere.
